In suitable controlled conditions, solid water changes directly to gas, or vapor directly to frost. These paths have no intermediate liquid. Keep the apparatus contained.

Liquid water can become gas by evaporation at its surface or boiling throughout the liquid. Cooling water vapor can form liquid droplets.
